card.name: Healthwise review and revision footer
card.fires_on: Pieces of the Healthwise patient-page footer: the year digits of a 'Last Revised' date, the colon or separator after 'Medical Review', and the word 'Reference' before reviewer names.

modes.label: Revision date digits
modes.description: Year digits in a 'Last Revised' date near the end of a Healthwise page.

modes.label: Reviewer list markers
modes.description: The colon, bar or word 'Reference' that comes right before a reviewer's name and specialty.

card.writes: It adds little beyond a weak push toward words like 'Recommendations' and 'Components', which suggest a new section heading.
card.plain: It lights up on the author, reviewer and revision-date footer at the bottom of Healthwise health pages.
